name: Ham (son of Noah)
title: Noah's second son and ancestor of African peoples
summary: Ham was one of Noah's three sons who survived the flood with his family in the ark. He is best known for the incident where he saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers about it, which led to Noah cursing Ham's son Canaan. Ham is regarded as the ancestor of several peoples, including Egyptians, Canaanites, and Cushites.

keyEvents.title: Survived the flood
keyEvents.description: Ham was one of the eight people who survived the great flood by entering the ark that Noah built at God's command.

keyEvents.title: Left the Ark
keyEvents.description: After the waters receded, Ham went out of the ark with his father, his brothers, and their wives to repopulate the earth.

keyEvents.title: Saw His Father's Nakedness
keyEvents.description: When Noah became drunk from wine and lay naked in his tent, Ham saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers instead of covering him.

keyEvents.title: The Curse on Canaan
keyEvents.description: When Noah awoke and understood what had happened, he cursed Ham's son Canaan to be a servant to his brothers.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of Many Nations
keyEvents.description: Ham's descendants spread out and became many nations, including the Egyptians (Mizraim), Cushites, Putites, and Canaanites who settled in areas of Africa and the Middle East.
